claim: The third quarter of fiscal 2024 revenue result fell 17% year over year at Microsoft.
summary: The claim states Microsoft Q3 FY2024 revenue fell 17% YoY. Based on model knowledge with a cutoff of 2026-01-04 and without tool evidence, Microsoft reported Q3 FY2024 (quarter ended March 31, 2024, announced April 25, 2024) revenue of about $61.9 billion, up ~17% year over year, not down 17%. The direction is inverted, contradicting the claim. No tools were used to verify.
